title: Brazil's top scorers since 2000
brief: Name the ten players with the most goals for Brazil in full internationals since 1 January 2000, to the 2026 World Cup final. Only goals from 2000 on count.
period: Full internationals from 1 January 2000 to 19 July 2026

notes.Rivaldo: Rivaldo scored 17 from 2000 on (35 in all).
notes.Roberto Firmino: Roberto Firmino is just outside with 17.
notes.Vinicius Junior: Vinicius Junior had 13 by the 2026 final.
notes.Romario: Romario scored only 11 of his 55 from 2000 on.

checks: Counted match by match: every Transfermarkt match report for the nation from 1 January 2000 to 19 July 2026 (starters plus substitutes who came on; scorers, own goals left out; results checked against each match's score, shoot-outs aside), then checked year by year against National Football Teams (its per-year player tables, FIFA and non-FIFA columns added together, September and October 2026 games taken off). Career totals also checked against RSSSF's record players page and Wikipedia (player infoboxes and caps-by-year tables), with games after 19 July 2026 taken off. Straddlers checked against their Wikipedia caps-by-year tables: Ronaldinho 26 (7 in 1999), Ronaldo 26, Rivaldo 17. Philippe Coutinho: Transfermarkt, National Football Teams and Wikipedia all give 21 (RSSSF 20); 21 used. Gabriel Jesus: Transfermarkt and Wikipedia give 19, RSSSF and National Football Teams 18 (they differ on one 2016 qualifier goal), so 10th is a pool with Fred on 18 (Fred's 18 includes two against the UAE in 2005, a friendly National Football Teams lists as non-FIFA because of eight substitutions; RSSSF, Wikipedia and Transfermarkt count it).
